trace_format.output_structure: Structured field-based format with [[ ## field ## ]] delimiters. [SYSTEM] defines expected input/output schema, [USER] provides inputs, agent expected to provide outputs in same format

architecture.topology_details: Single agent (solver) receives claim → analyzes passages → produces summary. The summary is used by an external retrieval system (not shown in traces) to fetch more passages, creating a three-hop retrieval loop. USER/coordinator provides inputs and orchestrates retrieval iterations. No multi-agent collaboration visible in traces - only human-in-the-loop or system-orchestrated retrieval cycles.
architecture.verification_details: The solver agent performs verification by analyzing claim against passages and identifying missing evidence. Instructions vary by trace: some request explicit identification of 'missing evidence documents', others focus on 'retrieval guidance'. No separate verifier agent - the same agent that analyzes also determines verification status. The [[ ## completed ## ]] field suggests workflow termination but no agent output is shown in traces.

critical_handoffs.what_is_passed: claim + passages retrieved from previous hop
critical_handoffs.failure_risk: If passages are irrelevant or solver misidentifies required evidence, subsequent retrieval hops will fetch wrong documents

critical_handoffs.what_is_passed: summary containing entities/topics for next retrieval hop
critical_handoffs.failure_risk: If summary doesn't explicitly name all entities needing verification, retrieval system cannot fetch necessary documents. Critical for multi-hop reasoning chains.
Retrieval may fail to find documents if solver's summary was vague or if documents don't exist in Wikipedia

solver.definition: Retrieves and returns Wikipedia passage content containing factual information about entities mentioned in claims. Acts as a document retrieval system that fetches relevant text passages.
solver.purpose: Retrieves Wikipedia passages for claim verification

coordinator.definition: Initiates tasks by providing claims to verify and system instructions. Sets up the verification task structure and defines the multi-hop retrieval workflow that other agents must execute.
coordinator.purpose: Initiates verification tasks and defines workflow structure
